sources.title: vasista22/whisper-tamil-large-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is a fine-tuned version of openai/whisper-large-v2 on the Tamil data available from multiple publicly available ASR corpuses. It has been fine-tuned as a part of the Whisper fine-tuning sprint.

sources.title: JairamKanna/whisper-large-v2-tamil · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the fine-tuned version of whisper-large-v2 model for Tamil language. The model follows the whisper architecture with the encoder-decoder part. Where the encoder used to create the embeddings from the speech input and the decoder used to give the textual outputs ...
